transcription.completion_note: Gate E Batch 5 directly re-read source pp.298-302 / printed pp.297-301 against the rendered controlling scan. No new source-reading uncertainty was found. The scan re-confirms the previously established p.298 source spacing பழனிசாமி ஏற்றுக் கொள்கிறாரோ and டி. மணி ஏற்றுக் கொள்கிறாரோ. During comparison, the current canonical transcript was found to have regressed those two forms to ஏற்றுக்கொள்கிறாரோ despite correction commit 8ed2c3685857e16b368139252386b623875284ab. They are recorded as pending canonical repairs and must be restored before Gate E can close. All other Batch-5 source-sensitive forms, including ரைட், 'TANCEM', 12-12-1994, Counter Affidavit English, the Tamil third-respondent sentence, the two Government English sentences, தயார் செய்வதன் / தயார் செய்து, production figures, அம்புஜா, Rs.85 / Rs.145, 50 சதவிகிதத்திலே and 111 cut motions, were re-confirmed. Gate E visual coverage is 25/26 pages; unresolved readings remain 0; Tamil is not verified.
